100 years after Svengali's legendary parties, we keep the spirit alive by reviving the gathering

See the Location

The House of Curiosities, an unique immersive experience

The company Abra-Cadabra, creator of the well acclaimed experimental cocktail lounge in Kyoto, l'Escamoteur Bar, invites you to experience their second chapter.

The House of Curiosities offers a unique theater experience, a strange, intimate, and freaky cabaret where boundaries between the stage and audience vanish.

Each evening, Svengali hosts various talented artists, making each night in central Kyoto unique and cinematic.

Step into the world of Svengali, a transformative journey blending circus, the world of magic and storytelling.

Svengali's Rules

IMPORTANT MESSAGE

  • Admission is for 14 and above.
  • Svengali is not responsible for any accidents, injuries, or damages at our venue.
  • The mask and cloak provided at the Castle must be worn during the show.
  • Reservation are highly recommended — Walk-ins accepted depending on availability, until the show begins.

Frequently Asked Questions

Doors open at 8:00PM. Please arrive early.

Yes, walk-ins may be accepted depending on availability, until the show begins. Svengali is an intimate experience with limited seating.

To ensure the best experience for everyone, entry is only possible before the start of the show. For guaranteed access and your preferred time, we strongly recommend booking in advance.

No, the gathering is different every night. We are pleased to present top-level artists, including world champions and medalists.

The show always feels special, as we host both Japanese and international guest artists. Each evening offers a unique experience!

The story will be told in both Japanese and English.

However, the show is designed to be enjoyable and talk-free, so regardless of language, the experience will be captivating and accessible to all.

No, there isn't a specific dress code. However, we really encourage you to come in your best outfit to make it a memorable occasion!

As our guest at Svengali's, you'll experience an immersive event where you are the honored guest.

Yes, masks must be worn during the show as they are an integral part of Svengali's story.

Additionally, a robe or cape will be provided for you to wear. All our masks are handcrafted by talented artisans in Venice and thoroughly disinfected after each use.

Yes, we provide masks specifically designed for glasses wearers.

They are made for comfort, ensuring you can enjoy the show without any discomfort.

Yes, we recommend reserving a seat on the 1st floor for more comfort if you're tall.

No, cocktails and champagne are included in your ticket price.

Yes, our masks are specially designed to allow drinking while wearing them, so you can enjoy your beverages throughout the event.

The minimum age required for the show is 14 years old, so unfortunately, kids are not allowed to attend.

No smoking is allowed anywhere in the venue.

Please inform our staff about any allergies when you arrive.

We'll review everything with you at the entrance to ensure your safety and comfort.

Drinks included with Gold and Silver tickets are served during the performance as part of the experience itself.

Additional drinks may be enjoyed before the show until 8:20 PM.

After the performance, the House of Curiosities remains open, and the evening continues with cocktails, champagne, music, and encounters with the artists.

Prepare for an unforgettable experience featuring amazing artists in a show unlike any other.

You'll embark on a transformative journey from darkness to light, filled with mystery, artistry, and wonder that will stay with you long after the final curtain.
